content: Phase 4.1: Profile/Settings page - change name, password, domains, retake quiz, delete account
Phase 4.2: Security hardening - rate limiting, input validation, DB indexes, error handling
Phase 4.3: UI/UX polish - user logout, error boundaries, settings gear icon, member stats
Phase 4.4: Admin power tools - search/filter users, story status filter
Phase 4.5: Production backend - proper error responses, logging, session management
Phase 4: End to end testing using Testing Agent
